page.overview:
What is Plateau of Sarkis?

The Plateau of Sarkis is a fictional location created by the late American author H. P. Lovecraft for his short story "Polaris".

The Plateau of Sarkis is a plateau in the far northern kingdom of Lomar in the Dreamlands. The plateau is the site of the city of Olathoë, and is situated in a hollow between the mountains Noton and Kadiphonek. (: "Polaris")
